startupWMClassSource: The window's X11 WM_CLASS instance and its Wayland app id: GLib's program name, the basename of argv[0]. Tauri leaves enableGTKAppId off, so tao 0.37 makes its gtk::Application with no id and nothing sets the program name; gtk::init passes the binary's argv[0], and the AppImage's AppRun starts the binary by its Exec= name, harness-device. GDK's X11 class is the same name capitalized (Harness-device); docks match StartupWMClass to the instance (GNOME, and the Wayland app id) or to the class ignoring case (KDE). Desktop's own harness.desktop names its program name the same way (kLinuxAppId).
